title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ French Vanilla Latte 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ French Vanilla Latte captures the comforting taste of freshly brewed coffee infused with smooth, creamy Vanilla. This indulgent blend delivers the bold, aromatic richness of coffee on the inhale, followed by a silky, mellow Vanilla sweetness. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid offers a consistently smooth throat hit and efficient nicotine absorption. The 50/50 VG/PG ratio ensures well-defined flavour with discreet vapour production, making it an excellent choice for pod systems and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids provide a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, delivering familiar and satisfying flavours in a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle is equipped with a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for added convenience.
